title: Redundant same-event port participation
domain: One fixed P/I/K/event/target/consumer binding with two named route-to-port occurrences and a declared challenge family
conditional_conclusion: A named two-port consumer can support non-exclusive participation by both redundant routes without either route being individually but-for necessary at every actual normal value; the claim is consumer-boundary indexed.
open_bridge: C1/R157 transport is conditional; B_pc^family, H_cf, measurement, report and subject count remain open.
proof_role: All 16 Boolean consumers are classified: four diagonal-correct, two dual-port contingent mechanisms, two projections, and zero satisfying universal two-port but-for on every normal row.
counterexamples: upstream two-port compiler feeding one-port consumer
